assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only shokugeki-no-soma:kobayashi-rindo@manga#reviewed-dedicated-analysis, the active_provisional V2 bounded character model SHOKUGEKI_RINDO_CHARACTER_MODEL.md (14,370 bytes) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the original Japanese manga V01-V36 including Le dessert. Its linked deep readings (D17, D18, D21, D23, D26, D27, D29-D31, D36), state, voice, relationship and readiness ledgers, evidence matrix, router and validation audits are not curated on this subject and were not used as evidence. The model's readiness label 'substantial' and its authority_state are inputs, not conclusions. No anime adaptation or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Six states as the model orders them: historical student texture from the lower-weight V21 bonus; the sociable Central member (D17, D18, D21, D23); the field-trained specialist (D26); the Régiment winner over Megishima and Takumi, with the visible fear Takumi notices (D26, D27, D29); the final partner and defeated peer who praises Erina's ideal (D30, D31); and the adult reviewer trajectory (D36), which the model makes its default when time is unspecified but leaves compressed. The record covers every state; in each it excludes the cause of the V29 fear and any ordering of her motives against Central loyalty beyond the located literal-rule decisions. Evidence is located by volume reading key and VV-NNN archive image, not by chapter-level state change; the serialized ending, Présent, Passé and Futur are kept distinct by the model.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives a governing thesis (appetite as a way of exploring people, places and ingredients, grounded in field learning, anatomy and exact sensory design), motives (tasting, discovery, companionship, serious competition), four rejected templates (chaotic foodie, harmless senior, secret rebel, fear explained by attachment to Tsukasa) and nine conditional rules, eight rated H. Not B: the model states that the ordering of these motives against her Central loyalty is not supplied and forbids filling it, and the cause of the V29 fear is U. When food-first interest and Central service pull apart beyond the located literal-rule cases (tickets, the literal pass), it cannot say which decides; that is undecided between competing motives, not uncertainty about wording or affect, and it sits at the centre of her character. Not D: each located choice is explained with an H rule, a stated exception and the predicted overreach that warmth and local help coexist with consequential alignment.

A six-row state table gives each state's available pattern and limit, from the V21 bonus through the Central member, field specialist, Régiment winner and final partner to the adult reviewer, with volume keys for each. Not B: the table orders states rather than explaining what changes her between them; the post-loss change is shown only as praise of Erina's ideal, no responsibility process follows, and the adult reviewer is compressed. Not D: the states carry distinct limits and located keys, and fatigue, fear and the shared loss are placed.

The model describes her speech as sociable, teasing, direct and capable of playful literalism; the same warmth can carry food enjoyment, assistance or an expulsion-bearing threat; technical explanation is exact; fear can produce evasion or a tonal break; familiarity with Tsukasa supports a different register. Not C: it locates no forms or lines, forbids an invented pronoun, honorific or nickname system, and conditions register by function rather than recipient apart from the single Tsukasa contrast. Not E: the warmth-with-threat and technical-exactness conditions discriminate between occasions.

Ordinary evidence is casual eating with students, teasing social intervention, the lower-weight V21 enthusiasm for more tasting and visible post-match exhaustion; the model states that the appetite is usable outside contests and that an unknown regional cook's preparation draws curiosity, direct questions and tasting with attention to method (probe 1, M scene, H method). Not C: it states that this is not a leisure or favorite-food inventory and that the adult reviewer's routine and travel are compressed. Not E: the appetite's transfer outside contests is stated and conditioned, not inferred from one scene.

The model distinguishes her conduct by recipient and gives the reason: with Tsukasa, familiarity and exact course collaboration; with Eizan, criticism of his fixation while staying aligned; with Megumi and Takumi, real evaluative power applied to the literal task; with Megishima, full effort and bodily cost; with Erina, post-loss admiration; an unknown cook attracts curiosity without inheriting any of these intimacies or obligations, and probe 2 contrasts Tsukasa with an unknown subordinate (H relation, M scene). Not A: each relation rests on one or two located patterns, and the emotional content of her closest relation (the fear's cause, any romance) is explicitly unresolved. Not C: the account says what changes her response from recipient to recipient and where it stops.

Interior evidence is the fear Takumi notices after their match and her evasion of a full explanation (D29), the lower-weight V21 image of standing beside Eishi in the rankings, and motives the model infers from her conduct. Not C: the one located interior affect has no recorded content, the model forbids supplying its cause, and her reasons for Central alignment are a named gap. Not E: the fear and its evasion are located and its presence is affirmed against the exuberant surface.

Conflict is located at the push for actual tasting against Eizan (D17, D18), the tickets given with a more dangerous test announced (D21), the 3-0 wins over Megishima and Takumi with collapse afterwards (D26, D27), the evasion of Takumi's question (D29) and the shared final-course loss (D30). Not B: interpersonal conflict outside competition is thin, and the response to a refusal of her help is an M/U row with no repeated pattern. Not D: competitive and institutional conflicts are each located with conditions and exceptions.

The model shows no moral deliberation of hers. Local conduct, such as insisting on tasting, providing tickets inside an adverse system and passing a literal task without political defection, supports bounded canon questions only; accountability and political motive are named gaps.

Teasing and playful literalism are stated in her register paragraph (keyed to D21, D23, D26 and D29), and the model routes excitement into tasting or teasing initiative. Not C: there is no account of when teasing stops, whom it targets beyond students, or how it changes under rank. Not E: the excitement-to-teasing route is a stated condition, not one scene.

The model draws on the complete V2 reading and keys its rules to ten volume readings, marks the V21 bonus and supplementary comics as lower weight, excludes defective or obscured images (26-137, 36-114, 36-258) and names its material gaps. Not B: it is a compact consolidation through analytical retrieval, its readings and ledgers are outside this evidence set, and the evaluator could not recheck any locator. Not D: each rule carries a located reading key.

Affirmative controls: the Megishima and Takumi results are 3-0 wins and collapse after a win is not a partial loss; the final-course loss is exact and preserves both cooks' contributions; providing tickets does not establish her innocence in the early departure or the wider system; passing Megumi and Takumi on the literal task is not political defection; praise of Erina does not supply accountability. Not B: several controls are analytic prohibitions (no fear-equals-romance, no unlimited stamina, no appetite as consent) rather than source facts. Not D: the source-fact controls are specific and decisive where they apply.

Rules are tied to named states and reading keys, the V21 bonus is marked lower weight, and the serialized ending and Le dessert parts are kept distinct. Not B: locators are volume-reading keys rather than chapter or page ranges, the motive ordering is undated, and the adult state is compressed.

conditions: Translated illustrative lines only, never presented as quotation, in a selected school state and one of the sampled relations: Tsukasa, Eizan, Megumi or Takumi, Megishima, Erina, or students in casual eating.

In those sampled relations, register follows the model: sociable, teasing and direct; exact when explaining technique; warmth may accompany an announced threat or test without signalling legitimacy; fear produces evasion or a tonal break, never a confession.

An unknown cook is a separate, lower-confidence case: lines show curiosity, direct questions about method and tasting of an unfamiliar preparation (probe 1, M scene, H method), without teasing or any familiarity inherited from the sampled relations.
No Japanese pronoun, honorific or nickname inventory, no food joke in every line, and no copy of Tsukasa's hesitant ordinary register.
No line that explains the V29 fear, declares a romance, apologizes for Central or describes adult reviewing practice.
scenario_readiness.note: The model constrains function and pragmatics enough for short illustrative lines in the sampled relations, not for Japanese forms or for the gaps it names; teasing stays with the sampled recipients.

conditions: A novel ingredient, fieldwork, butchery, judging or partnered-course situation governed by the model's rules: an unfamiliar ingredient or practice draws tasting, investigation and functional use in a dish; a stated task is judged literally; serious opposition draws full effort with visible exertion afterwards; a partner's dish draws precise sequencing of acid, texture and timing.

In a Central-era state, local help to adversaries is limited to what the located cases show (insisting on tasting, practical tickets, a literal pass) and comes without political defection; whether she would defy a Central instruction that excludes tasting or harms students is not predicted.

The interlocutor is Tsukasa, Eizan, Megumi, Takumi, Megishima, Erina or an unknown cook; an unknown subordinate or cook does not inherit Tsukasa's familiarity, and any warmer transfer is a separate, lower-confidence case.
Abstain on the fear's cause, a romance, a secret political plan, an apology or restitution for Central, ordinary refusal policy and adult reviewing practice (probes 3 and 4, U).

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: A named school state from the sociable Central member through the Régiment wins, the final course with Tsukasa and the praise of Erina; the adult reviewer only as the established professional fact, with no routine or private detail.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Tsukasa as course partner, Eizan as Central colleague, Megumi, Takumi or Megishima as examinee or opponent, Erina after the loss, or an unknown cook as a separate, lower-confidence case.
setting_constraints: A kitchen, a culinary competition or examination, a field or regional-ingredient setting, or Central-era institutional work.
No domestic, romantic or private setting beyond casual eating with students, and no anime adaptation material.
Culinary mechanism, judging and institutions follow their specialist routes, which are outside this evidence set.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation within the culinary, evaluative and field contexts the model samples; her motive ordering against Central loyalty and the fear's cause are excluded.

conditions: Casual eating with students, as sampled: food enjoyment, curiosity and teasing social intervention.
Separately, an unknown cook offering an untasted preparation draws curiosity, direct questions about method and tasting (probe 1, M scene, H method); teasing with that recipient is not established.
Exhaustion is plausible after serious exertion; no unlimited-energy default.
No leisure inventory, favorite-food ranking, domestic routine or adult private life is supplied.
scenario_readiness.note: Only the food-centered sociability the model states is usable outside contests.
The model shows no moral deliberation of hers, leaves political motive and accountability as named gaps and marks an ordinary apology about Central U (probe 4).

The model rejects explaining her fear by attachment to Tsukasa, treats the V21 bonus as no romance account, forbids inferring romantic or sexual voracity from appetite or fanservice framing, and abstains from confirmed romance.

conditions: Rare ingredients, travel-based learning, anatomy and butchery, culinary adaptation, coordinated course composition and literal task evaluation.
An unusual ingredient is justified by what it does in the dish, not by rarity; exact wins and the exact shared loss are preserved.
No universal mastery of all cuisines, no harmless authority, and no detailed adult reviewing methodology or schedule.
scenario_readiness.note: Her strongest domains are fieldwork-grounded cooking and partnered course design.

known_limits.statement: The fear Takumi notices after their comparison is evidenced, but its cause is U; the model forbids explaining it by romantic attachment to Tsukasa or any other supplied motive.

The model states that the ordering of tasting, companionship and competition against her Central loyalty is not supplied and forbids filling it with a hidden rescue plan or with indifference to consequences.
No responsibility or restitution process follows the final loss; warm acknowledgment of Erina and the reviewer destination do not demonstrate correction of her Central participation.
Her response when an unknown person refuses a casual offer of help is an M/U row; a repeated respect-for-refusal pattern is not established.
The adult reviewer trajectory is the model's default when time is unspecified, but its routine judgments, private life, travel and accountability are compressed.
The model forbids inventing a pronoun, honorific or nickname system and claims no acting, pitch or accent traits.
The V21 bonus and supplementary comics carry lower weight; the bonus is not a complete motive or romance account.

The deep readings, voice, state, relationship and readiness ledgers, the evidence matrix and the validation and fidelity audits are not curated on this subject, so no locator was rechecked and no probe result is in this evidence set.
The model is one compact synthesis of a 36-volume reading; its four probes are noncanonical examples with stated confidence, not test outcomes.
